scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging api d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/wrangler.mjs production api d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:policies:staging: node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging api d1 execute DB --remote --file=seeds/username-policies.sql
scripts.db:policies:production: node scripts/wrangler.mjs production api d1 execute DB --remote --file=seeds/username-policies.sql
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run check && pnpm run db:migrate:staging && pnpm run db:policies:staging && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging api deploy && pnpm run media:upload && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging web deploy
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run check && pnpm run db:migrate:production && pnpm run db:policies:production && node scripts/wrangler.mjs production api deploy && pnpm run media:upload && node scripts/wrangler.mjs production web deploy
